key_insight: Knowledge Fusion Network (KFN) reduces catastrophic forgetting by adding novelty-gated channel capacity instead of forcing new tasks into fixed shared parameters.
engineering_relevance: KFN could support engineering models that learn sequentially from new datasets, although the abstract does not validate solid-mechanics or constitutive-modeling applications.
method: Learn each incoming task in an isolated 2.8M-parameter specialist.
Fuse specialists into the global model using novelty-conditioned channel allocation.
Protect consolidated knowledge through channel separation and phased gradient unfreezing.
evidence_signal: On Split CIFAR-100 and EuroSAT, KFN reports class-incremental retention of 72.7% and 42.5%, versus best-baseline values of 29.6% and 0.94%; ten-task model size is 28.1M parameters versus 112.0M for naive backbone duplication.
watch_item: Capacity still grows with tasks, and reported CIFAR-100 forgetting remains substantial at 57.92%.
paper_title: Learning without Overwriting: Structural Knowledge Fusion for Continual Learning
